ACCESS_ROLES.DESCRIPTION: What each person sees and can do according to their role. Change a role's options and it applies to every agent with that role. The Administrator sees everything and cannot be edited.
ACCESS_ROLES.RESTORE_CONFIRM: Restore the role «{name}» to its defaults? Your changes will be lost.
ACCESS_ROLES.AREAS_TITLE: Where they go and what they see
ACCESS_ROLES.ADMIN_NOTE: The Administrator can access, see and do everything. It cannot be edited so nobody gets locked out.

ROLE_HINTS.SUPERVISOR: Sees everything except Settings. Agents without another role get this one.
ROLE_HINTS.SELLER: Sales, their conversations, agenda and clients; only their own.
ROLE_HINTS.TECHNICIAN: Service, their conversations, agenda and clients; only their own and without amounts.
ROLE_HINTS.VIEWER: Only Reports and My business, read-only (a partner, the accountant).
